tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background, the ground everything sits on.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tables and dialogs laid on the page, like a sheet on the table.

tokens.name: surface-subtle
tokens.usage: Table headers and footers, hover rows, quiet panels.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, card borders and row dividers. Decorative; never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders; 3:1 or more on paper and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, body text and the ink logo, on paper, surface and surface-subtle.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Meta, labels, column heads and help text, on paper, surface and surface-subtle.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders and disabled text only. Under 4.5:1 by design: never for text that must be read.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: The brand: primary buttons, links, selection, active nav and the logo. As text, on paper, surface or slate-tint.

tokens.name: slate-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of slate fills and links.

tokens.name: slate-tint
tokens.usage: Selected rows, the active nav item, the shared work area on The Table.

tokens.name: on-slate
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a slate fill, such as the Sign button.

tokens.name: copper
tokens.usage: People: the Mezonas lead, human sign-offs, notes from a person. As text, on paper or surface. Never in the logo.

tokens.name: copper-ink
tokens.usage: Copper text on copper-tint, such as the lead's initials.

tokens.name: copper-tint
tokens.usage: Behind a person: the lead's avatar ground, a note from your lead.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Waiting on you: approvals, price changes, overdue items. A fill only, with ink text on it, always paired with a word. Never text on paper.

tokens.name: signal-ink
tokens.usage: Signal text on signal-tint.

tokens.name: signal-tint
tokens.usage: Backgrounds for signal messages and rows.

tokens.name: risk
tokens.usage: Errors, failed runs and real risk, always with a word. As text, on paper or surface.

tokens.name: risk-ink
tokens.usage: Risk text on risk-tint.

tokens.name: risk-tint
tokens.usage: Backgrounds for errors and risk messages.

tokens.name: risk-line
tokens.usage: Border of risk banners.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Done, paid, signed, always with a word. As text, on paper or surface.

tokens.name: positive-tint
tokens.usage: Backgrounds behind positive text: signed and paid pills.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid 2px slate ring with a 2px paper gap.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links, an alias of slate.

tokens.name: data-bar
tokens.usage: Magnitude bars in tables.

tokens.name: data-track
tokens.usage: The track behind a bar or bullet.

tokens.name: data-line
tokens.usage: Sparklines and the strongest mark.

tokens.name: data-up
tokens.usage: Diverging pole for increases (cool).

tokens.name: data-down
tokens.usage: Diverging pole for decreases (warm). Data color, not risk.

tokens.name: data-up-soft
tokens.usage: Soft step toward data-up.

tokens.name: data-down-soft
tokens.usage: Soft step toward data-down.

tokens.name: data-mid
tokens.usage: Neutral midpoint of the diverging set.

tokens.name: data-seq-1
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp step 1 of 5, one slate hue light to dark; steps 4 and 5 take on-slate text.

tokens.name: data-seq-2
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp step 2 of 5, one slate hue light to dark; steps 4 and 5 take on-slate text.

tokens.name: data-seq-3
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp step 3 of 5, one slate hue light to dark; steps 4 and 5 take on-slate text.

tokens.name: data-seq-4
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp step 4 of 5, one slate hue light to dark; steps 4 and 5 take on-slate text.

tokens.name: data-seq-5
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp step 5 of 5, one slate hue light to dark; steps 4 and 5 take on-slate text.

groups.name: Brand
groups.note: Geist (Google Fonts). The wordmark ships as outlined SVG in the Logos group; this style is for reference only.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The name in the logo: capitals, tracked 300. Use the logo files, not live text.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Site hero and cover lines only.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Geist for everything you read and use. Every number uses tabular figures, right-aligned in tables.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: We drafted four payment reminders. Sign and they go out today.

groups.name: References
groups.note: Geist Mono (Google Fonts) for eyebrows and references only; amounts stay in Geist with tabular figures.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Section eyebrows and card kickers, in capitals.

styles.name: reference
styles.usage: Invoice numbers, record IDs, receipt references.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a control.

tokens.name: space-1-5
tokens.usage: Tight gaps between an icon and a short label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between a label and its value; icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2-5
tokens.usage: Row padding in dense lists.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between items in a dense list.

tokens.name: space-3-5
tokens.usage: Inner padding of banners and before/after boxes.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; gaps between related items; phone page margins.

tokens.name: space-4-5
tokens.usage: Key/value row padding in cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between form fields.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; grid gutter; tablet page margins.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between sections in the app.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Large panel padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Site page margins on desktop.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between sections on the site.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, tags, small buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, tables.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The Table's main surface, dialogs, large panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills and count badges only.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: The selected segment and the switch knob only.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, dialogs and toasts. Nothing else lifts; cards use a line border.

tokens.name: focus-halo
tokens.usage: Soft halo outside the 2px focus-ring on inputs and buttons.

tokens.name: icon-opacity
tokens.usage: Icons shown through (they draw black): brings them to a muted grey on light grounds. Inline SVG icons use currentColor instead.

tokens.name: scrim-opacity
tokens.usage: The ink scrim behind dialogs and sheets.

tokens.name: header-h
tokens.usage: App header height.

tokens.name: sidebar-w
tokens.usage: Sidebar width.

tokens.name: sidebar-collapsed-w
tokens.usage: Collapsed sidebar width.

tokens.name: row-h-dense
tokens.usage: Ledger table rows.

tokens.name: row-h-compact
tokens.usage: Compact table rows.

tokens.name: row-h
tokens.usage: Default table rows.

tokens.name: row-h-comfortable
tokens.usage: List rows.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs; 44px on touch.
